RESOLUTION (Phase 050): one rule for every attempt. An attempt has a capability C (what the actor brings: force, technique, fit, team, conditions) and a demand D (what the thing asks: a container's toughness or lock strength, scaled by its condition). rho = C / D maps, with no randomness, to progress, stamina cost, strain, wear and noise. The pure function is worlds/resolution.py; this table holds its numbers.

REFERENCE POINT. An average adult (effective strength 1.0, body size 1.0, full reserve, health 1.0), at intensity 1.0, with technique 1.0 (skill 1.0), a tool that fits (fit 1.0), no team (neutral_team 1.0) and normal conditions (neutral_conditions 1.0), has C = 1.0. A demand of 1.0 is one such adult's push. Recipes (Phases 022 and 023) keep their own mechanism: their cost passes through cost_ratio with floor 1, and a worker who meets the strength gate has D/C at most 1, so the declared cost is paid as before.

VERBS are in the VERBS table of this file. MATERIALS gives each material's hardness, toughness, fragility and noise. Every number here is APPROX unless a source is given. The sources below are for the order of magnitude only.

HARDNESS. hardness is on a 0 to 1 scale that only orders materials. The Mohs scale (Mohs, 1822) puts iron at about 4.5 and granite at 6 to 7; the values here (metal 0.6, stone 0.9) keep that order but are not a conversion of it (APPROX). Wood, cloth, leather and wax are not on the Mohs scale; their values are APPROX.

RESOLUTION keys. attempt_cap_rate: the most progress one attempt can make, in multiples of the reference (2.0: an attempt can run at up to twice the reference, so force above the reference still shows as more damage). progress_exponent: progress = min(attempt_cap_rate, rho^progress_exponent). technique_floor: technique = technique_floor + (1 - technique_floor) x effective skill; an unskilled worker keeps half the technique. base_cost: stamina per attempt at rho = 1 (APPROX; 0.1 is a tenth of a unit of reserve, the scale of the Phase 022 recipe costs). floor and effort_cap: the bounds on the cost ratio clamp(D/C, floor, effort_cap); attempts use floor 0. k: the exponent of intensity on stamina (an attempt at twice the intensity costs more than twice as much when k > 1). i_safe and m: strain past the safe intensity is max(0, i - i_safe)^m, paid whether or not the attempt works. max_intensity: the clamp on the requested intensity (the reserve, exhaustion and health lower the ceiling further). unrelated_fit: the fit of a tool whose verb is not in a verb's tool_verbs. hands_fit: the fit of bare hands for any verb (0.05, the seed's floor for bare hands, Phase 048). A tool's fitness for a verb is in the TOOL_FIT table (closeness, hardness, edge, weight, quality, condition). The job's stamina goes up by 1 / fit up to effort_cap. neutral_team and neutral_conditions: 1.0 until Phases 047 (joint actions) and the conditions terms give them values. tool_wear: wear per attempt on a tool that fits, at intensity 1. mismatch_wear: how much more a tool wears when it does not fit (its wear is multiplied by 1 + mismatch_wear x (1 - fit)). hardness_wear: how much more it wears against a harder material (multiplied by 1 + hardness_wear x (target hardness - tool hardness)). damage_per_attempt: condition lost by a target in one attempt at progress 1 (scaled by the material's fragility as 0.5 + fragility). lock_material: the material a lock is taken to be made of for hardness and noise. default_material: the material taken for a container whose kind has no material in ITEMS. noise_base: loudness of one attempt at intensity 1 for a material noise factor of 1.0; it is a radius in cells (Phase 028). strain_limit: the strain at which the actor takes one accident harm, and the strain resets. accident_harm: the health lost at each accident (through harm(..., 'accident')).

PHASE 050b KEYS (all APPROX; model choices, not measured). haste_cap, care_cap: the pace of a recipe job (intensity on transform) is clamped to [1 / care_cap, haste_cap]; a faster job runs at up to haste_cap times the reference rate, a slower one at 1 / care_cap. haste_penalty: quality defect added per unit of pace above 1 (defect = 1 + haste_penalty x (pace - 1); below 1 the defect equals the pace). haste_yield_loss: output lost per unit of pace above 1. ruin_below: a batch the pace pushes below this quality is spoiled (its output is lost, its inputs are consumed); a batch already below it at pace 1 is not spoiled by the pace. trivial_below, slot_above: the cost share (stamina share, with intensity) below which an attempt is free of stamina, and below which it leaves the action slot unspent; the same values as CONTEST (Phase 029), which keeps its own copies. strain_sleep_recovery: strain a sleeping resident sheds per clock tick (a tick is 15 minutes, TIME.minutes_per_tick). push_mass_unit: the load (in ITEMS weight units; APPROX, the scale of the pack's item weights) that an average adult pushes at normal intensity over level ground, the demand of 1.0 for a displacement; push_cells_per_surplus and push_max_cells: a displacement moves floor(surplus x push_cells_per_surplus) cells, at most push_max_cells, where the surplus is capability minus demand. NOT IN THIS TABLE (later phases). Quality and yield curves for a recipe's inputs beyond the pace terms above, the escalation policy of the simple backend (cheap.py), throw and blows (Phase 038), and lift and carry (not implemented; see VERBS).

PHASE 049 KEYS (all APPROX; model choices, not measured). skill_ruin_ratio: a recipe batch whose working skill is below this share of the recipe's min_skill floor is spoiled (its inputs are used and it yields nothing). Above that line the yield falls in step with the skill's share of the floor. off_season_yield: the share of a batch's yield kept when a seasonal recipe (one with seasons) is worked out of its season. unserved_waste: the share of a meal lost when it is eaten without the serving vessel and utensil, or from a vessel too small for it. leak_per_period: the share of a leaky vessel's fluid (one that is not watertight) lost each period. PHASE 048 KEYS (all APPROX; model choices, not measured). fit_quality_loss: a finished batch's quality falls by this share of its shortfall in fit (quality x (1 - fit_quality_loss x (1 - fit))). waste_below: a job whose tool fit falls below this consumes its inputs and yields nothing. VERBS.work: the physical work class a verb needs (smash and hit need a strike, open and pry a pierce); a tool's closeness is read against it in TOOL_FIT. TOOL_FIT: the verbs, the near pairs of verbs (symmetric; unlisted pairs take unrelated_fit), the verbs that need an edge and the tool kinds that have one, the verbs that need weight, the weight at which a tool counts as heavy enough, the hardness gap at which a softer tool gives no fit, and authored rows (a tool's own fitness for a verb, with its effort). Pair values are APPROX, ordered by closeness of use (chop and cleave, cut and cleave, cut and saw, cut and pierce) and not sourced; the hardness scale is the one described under MATERIALS.

smash.description: Break a thing by hard blows: a container's condition falls until it breaks.

hit.description: Strike a thing once or often with a held object. Damage primitive, as smash, with a blow's lower fit.

cut.description: Cut into a thing with an edge.

chop.description: Chop into a thing with an axe-like edge.

saw.description: Saw through a thing with a saw.

dig.description: Shift earth or stone out of the ground. Displace primitive, not implemented yet, so refused as unsupported.

push.description: Push a thing along the ground, away from you. Displace primitive: the load's mass over friction and terrain against your force; the surplus moves it by whole cells.

pull.description: Pull a thing along the ground toward you. Displace primitive, as push, in the other direction.

lift.description: Lift a thing off the ground into your hands. Displace primitive, not implemented yet, so refused as unsupported.

carry.description: Carry a thing on the body. Displace primitive, not implemented yet, so refused as unsupported.

throw.description: Throw a thing through the air. Displace primitive, not implemented yet (blows and throws belong to Phase 038), so refused as unsupported.

open.description: Open a lock or lid by force.

pry.description: Force a lock or lid by levering it with a bar or a thin tool.

force.description: Break a lock by weight and blows.

walk.description: Walk to a place: the world's move action.

eat.description: Eat food you hold: the world's eat action.

drink.description: Drink a drink you hold: the world's eat action (drinks are foods).

sleep.description: Lie down and sleep: the world's sleep action.

rest.description: Rest to recover stamina: the world's rest action.

sow.description: Sow seed on a field: the world's sow action.

harvest.description: Harvest a crop: the world's harvest action.

cook.description: Cooking is a recipe: work it with the recipe action, not an attempt. Refused as unsupported here.

mend.description: Mending is a recipe or a maintenance action: not an attempt. Refused as unsupported here.

drag.description: Drag a thing along the ground toward you, by a rope or by hand. Displace primitive, as pull.
